# Yahoo Finance

> > Comprehensive financial platform providing real-time market data, stock quotes, currency conversion, and investment research tools.

Yahoo Finance serves as a leading financial information portal offering market data for stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, futures, and cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin USD. The platform provides essential tools for investors tracking major indices like the S&P 500 and individual companies such as Adobe Inc., Airbnb, Inc., Block, Inc., and other publicly traded entities.

## Key Topics

- Market Data & Stock Quotes
- Symbol Lookup & Ticker Search
- Currency Converter & Exchange Rates
- S&P 500 Index
- Bitcoin USD & Cryptocurrencies
- Trending Tickers
- Stock Prices & Financial Markets
- Adobe Inc., Airbnb, Inc., Block, Inc.
- Ulta Beauty, MercadoLibre, Royal Caribbean
- Rubrik, SentinelOne, Blackstone
- Exchange Calculator Tools
- Investment Research
- Real-time Financial Data

## Core Financial Tools

- [Symbol Lookup from Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/lookup?s=ERI): Search tool for ticker symbols across stocks, ETFs, mutual funds & futures
- [Currency converter | Currency exchange calculator – Yahoo Finance](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/currency-converter/): Live currency converter and exchange rate calculator with market news
